title: Speedy trial is a facet of Article 21 (Hussainara Khatoon)

content.overview: Speedy trial is a facet of Article 21 (Hussainara Khatoon). The BNSS adds clocks: charge-framing, day-to-day trial (s. 346), judgment in 45 days (s. 392 teaching), and s. 479 undertrial release. The doctrine is constitutional; the clocks are statutory.
